reconstructions.reconstructed_text: For four [gates o]pen in each world, distributed at the four points of the compass, opening downwards to the vessels. So, due to this, the [light of the] rays shall go in through these openings and it shines on [that] place, and pulls through them the light and the little pi[llar that ex]ists there.

From that place [it] shall be poured [out to the] firmaments. It shall also be clarified in these firmaments [, and of what is clarified,] a part there is cleansed and it is [all] taken up with the living ones. However, its other part [, that which is of the darkness and the mixture,] shall all [be cast] down.

[The enlightener said
:] b[u]t should

, it is drawn up by the]
 light of the rays that [are sent
 down and] which are received, which
 shine and go in through these great open
 gates, through these doors, firmament
 by firmament.
